avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam contains potassium; concurrent supplementation increases hyperkalemia risk, especially in renal impairment
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless serum levels are monitored; check product formulation for potassium content

avoid_supplements.name: Sodium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Formulation contains sodium; excessive intake may worsen fluid retention or hypertension in susceptible patients
avoid_supplements.action: Limit additional sodium supplementation; monitor fluid status and blood pressure

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Beta-lactam antibiotics disrupt normal flora; timing separation may optimize probiotic colonization
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours; consider during and after therapy to restore microbiota

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Aminopenicillins may chelate magnesium in GI tract; monitor for deficiency with prolonged therapy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor magnesium levels during extended treatment courses

caution_foods.name: High potassium foods (bananas, spinach, coconut water, avocado)
caution_foods.mechanism: Drug contains potassium; cumulative intake may elevate serum levels, particularly in renal dysfunction
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake if renal function is impaired; monitor serum potassium

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods (processed foods, canned goods, salt)
caution_foods.mechanism: Formulation contains sodium; excessive dietary sodium may contribute to fluid retention
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent sodium intake; monitor for edema or hypertension

monitoring_notes: Piperacillin-tazobactam undergoes minimal metabolism and is primarily renally excreted; monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium), and signs of C. difficile infection during therapy. Assess baseline potassium and sodium levels, especially in patients with renal impairment.
